# Dr. Aswanth Krishnan

> First-year MD Pharmacology resident at K S Hegde Medical Academy, Mangaluru, Karnataka, India. Builds open-source medical education tools for pharmacology study, revision and accessible reading.

## Person

- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/draswanth/): Professional profile of Dr. Aswanth Krishnan.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/aswanthwuhan): Open-source repositories, including the projects listed below.

## Medical education projects

- [PharmaReader](https://aswanthwuhan.github.io/pharmareader/): Offline study reader with on-device TTS, pharma pronunciation, FSRS flashcards and the NMC syllabus map. GPL-3.0. [Source and downloads](https://github.com/aswanthwuhan/pharmareader)
- [Pharmacards](https://aswanthwuhan.github.io/Pharma-Cards/): MD Pharmacology flashcards with FSRS spaced repetition, Rapid Fire recall and offline study on web/PWA, Windows, macOS and Android. [Source](https://github.com/aswanthwuhan/Pharma-Cards)
- [BCBR Quiz App](https://bcbr-quiz-app.vercel.app/): Free question bank of 1000+ MCQs across all 23 assignments, plus flashcards, for the ICMR Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) exam. MIT. Web, Android and desktop. [Source](https://github.com/aswanthwuhan/BCBR-QUIZ-APP)

## Developer tools

- [OpenCode Slides Plugin](https://github.com/aswanthwuhan/opencode-slides-plugin): View, edit and comment on PowerPoint decks in a side panel of OpenCode Desktop, and send slides to the AI model.
- [OpenReader on Android](https://github.com/aswanthwuhan/openreader-android): Run OpenReader, a self-hosted read-along document reader with TTS, on Android via Termux and proot.

## Note

These are independent educational projects, not institutional products or medical advice.
